precondition.description: A customer supplies an exact prose-only commission bound by digest to its assignment, admitted research packet, licensed editorial state, writing law, style law, required source URLs, and finite LISS route policy.

move.description: Newswire Editorial Production offers the exact commission, contracts LISS for the admitted cheapest-sufficient route, and returns the resulting prose with the complete upstream provider result.

postcondition.description: The customer receives either prose bound to the exact commission and LISS receipt, a dry-run readiness witness with no prose, or a typed obstruction. Newswire never writes the customer's manuscript or publication state.

constraints: customer filesystem paths and mutation authority are inadmissible
models return prose rather than serialized newsroom records
provider failure is returned as obstruction and never causes Newswire to invent a new route
the accepted customer capability and child LISS capability preserve the exact offered effects and route scope
credentials enter only the invocation environment and are never recorded
